description_en: Lists the snapshot chains in a region that match your criteria
description_zh: 查询某个地域下满足条件的快照链
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs list-snapshot-links --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --filter-key FsId --filter-value dbfs-kwziq4dpsle00000000 --fs-ids dbfs-kwziq4dpsle00000000_,_dbfs-vuaqvfcjqsg00000000 --link-ids sl-bp1grgphbcc9brb50000_,_sl-bp1c4izumvq0i5bs0000_,_sl-bp1akk7isz866dds0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSnapshotLinks

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.

Maximum: 100.

Default: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页条数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The filter key used to list snapshot chains.

Use with FilterValue. Valid values: LinkId or FsId.

If you set FilterKey to LinkId, the operation filters by snapshot chain ID. If you set FilterKey to FsId, the operation filters by file system ID
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照链时的筛选键。

与FilterValue配合使用，取值必须为LinkId或FsId。

传入LinkId则根据快照链ID进行筛选，传入FsId则根据文件系统ID进行筛选
parameters.name: filter_key

parameters.help_en:
The filter value used to list snapshot chains.

Use with FilterKey
parameters.help_zh:
查询快照链时的筛选值。

与FilterKey配合使用
parameters.name: filter_value

parameters.help_en: The IDs of database file systems. You can specify up to 100 IDs. Format the value as a JSON array. Separate IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 数据库文件系统ID。一次最多指定100个文件系统ID。FsIds参数取值格式为JSON数组，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: fs_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of snapshot chains. You can specify up to 100 IDs. Format the value as a JSON array. Separate IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 快照链ID。一次最多指定100个快照ID。LinkIds参数取值格式为JSON数组，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: link_ids
